{{Infobox auto}}

An '''apple empanada''' is the meal of the [[apple]]. It heals {{Value|Apple Empanada|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for {{Value|Apple Empanada|duration|effect=Regeneration}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/apple_empanada.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Apple|baked apple]], sugar, estus ash and [[dough]]. Obtaining a baked apple unlocks the recipe.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating an apple empanada takes {{Value|Apple Empanada|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Apple Empanada|heals}} and gives Regeneration {{Value|Apple Empanada|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Apple Empanada|duration|effect=Regeneration|format=clock}}.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_0.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
